caption: The plug of a lit table lamp is pulled out of the wall socket, and the lamp goes out.

sa.check: Its plug is in a wall socket.
The plug is pulled out of the socket.
A cord connects the lamp to the plug.
The order is lit, plug pulled, out.

pc.expect: The lamp goes dark at the moment the plug leaves the socket, and only then.
pc.fail: The plug is out and the lamp still shines; or the lamp goes out before the plug moves; or the lamp goes out with the plug still seated.

pc.expect: Once unplugged the lamp stays dark; it does not relight while the plug is out.
pc.fail: The lamp comes back on while the plug is out; or flickers between lit and dark; or keeps glowing for the rest of the clip after being unplugged.

pc.expect: The light the lamp cast disappears with it: the shade darkens and the surfaces it lit go dimmer.
pc.fail: The bulb goes dark while its light on the table and wall stays; or the room brightens as the lamp goes out; or the shade keeps glowing with the bulb dark.

pc.expect: The cord follows the plug: it slackens and drops when pulled free and stays attached at both ends.
pc.fail: The cord stretches like elastic; or stands rigid in the air after the plug is out; or floats.

pc.expect: One lamp, one cord, one plug and one socket; the plug leaves the socket whole and nothing passes through the wall or table.
pc.fail: The plug vanishes or a second plug appears; or the plug passes through the wall; or the socket moves; or the cord splits or detaches; or the lamp changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The lamp's shade colour and the room stay the same apart from the light.
pc.fail: The shade changes colour rather than brightness; or the wall changes; or the socket's design changes.
